Fixed points

The identity project works from first principles with two fixed points, and everything else is open. No decision is protected by the effort already spent on it; a proposal is judged on the success criteria alone.

Fixed

General Translation

The company's legal name does not change.

gt, gt-next, gt-react, gt-vue, gt-node, gt-python

The names customers install and import do not change.

npm i gt-next
import { T } from 'gt-next';
npx gt translate

Open

The mark The colors The type The layout system The voice The site structure The deck itself The product names, including Locadex
